toolsPreview.name: preflight_check
toolsPreview.description: CALL THIS BEFORE fetching, crawling, scraping, opening, or browser-rendering an unfamiliar http/https URL. PREFLIGHT cheaply decides the best first machine route: HTTP, BROWSER, MACHINE_ENDPOINT, or AVOID, with access/JS/size/cost hints. Use the ACTUAL destination URL from the current task, not example.com or a synthetic demo URL.

toolsPreview.name: preflight_feedback
toolsPreview.description: After following a PREFLIGHT recommendation, report whether that route succeeded or failed. This improves future routing for the same URL/domain.
